To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of content-based and collaborative filtering approaches to followee recommendation can be highly effective.

1) the real-time web can provide a rich and diverse set of features for profiling and recommendation; 2) content-based recommendation strategies based on the real-time web outperform traditional collaborative filtering techniques; and 3) the combination of the real-time web and collaborative filtering can be used to improve the effectiveness of followee recommendations.
we have demonstrated that real-time web services such as Twitter provide a fertile ground on which to build recommender systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of recommending Twitter users to follow.
the following research question: How can we exploit the content and social aspects of real-time, social web data to recommend new followees to a given user?
the recommendation problem of which Twitter users to suggest to a particular user, UT, as a followee, based on the content of UT's tweets and those of his/her current followees.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the real-time web is a rich source of information that can be used to profile users and recommend followees, and that this is a fertile area for recommender systems researchers to explore.

our results show that the use of real-time data can improve recommendation performance and that the use of a combination of content-based and collaborative filtering techniques can be very effective for followee recommendation.
the content based approach outperforms the collaborative filtering approach in the followee recommendation problem.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can recommend users who have similar interests and are active on Twitter.
we are able to provide a recommendation of a followee for a user with an accuracy of 0.8.
we can achieve a 10% improvement in precision and 5% improvement in recall, over a random approach, by using a combination of collaborative and content-based filtering approaches.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to recommend followees to users in a timely and accurate manner.

it is possible to recommend followees to Twitter users based on the content and the social context of the user and the candidate followee, and that the recommendation quality can be further improved by using a combination of content and collaborative filtering.
real-time content-based approaches are effective at recommending followees, and can be used to augment the performance of collaborative approaches.
